text: dsh-custom-style 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的界面样式插件，在设置中加入「自定义样式」面板，并由宿主路由提供本地 CSS。用户可在面板调整弹窗、导航、字号和页面宽度，选择本机图片作为壁纸，或直接编辑多个 CSS 文件；文件按名称合并，客户端约每两秒拉取更新。适合希望个性化 DSH 外观、维护自定义界面规则的用户。样式默认保存在 DSH_HOME 下，无需 API Key。

dsh-custom-style adds a custom CSS panel to the DSH web client. Adjust dialog size, navigation, text, and page width; choose a local wallpaper or edit CSS files directly. The client reloads styles about every two seconds. Styles are stored under DSH_HOME; no API key is needed.
想在 DSH 设置里直接调弹窗大小、字号和界面样式。
让自定义 CSS 保存后自动应用到 DSH，不用每次重启。
I want to customize the DSH settings screen with my own CSS and see changes reload automatically.
dsh-custom-style 的功能「自定义 CSS 面板」：在设置中调整弹窗、导航、字号和页面宽度，并将修改写入样式文件。
dsh-custom-style 的功能「样式自动注入」：宿主合并 CSS 文件并提供本地样式路由，客户端定时更新页面样式；也可选择本机图片用作背景。
dsh-custom-style 使用外部壁纸 URL 时，浏览器会按 CSS 中的图片地址加载内容；选取本机图片则保存到样式目录。
dsh-custom-style 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 25 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-custom-style README · dsh-custom-style：[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

把你自己写的 CSS 注入 **DeepSeek Harness** 界面——设置弹窗宽度、字号、配色、间距，想改什么就改什么。
只需编辑 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-style/` 下的 `*.css` 文件，**保存约 2 秒后自动生效**：不改应用本体、不重新打包、不重启。

它还会在 **DSH 设置界面里加一栏「自定义样式」**：用几个常用数值一键调整弹窗宽度、高度、正文字号与内容居中，或是设置一张带磨砂遮罩的全屏背景图——不用离开应用就能调界面。

dsh-custom-style README · dsh-custom-style：- **宿主半身**（`index.js`）：把 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-style/*.css` 按文件名顺序拼成一张样式表，经
  `GET /dsh-custom-style/all.css` 提供；首次运行自动创建目录并播种起始样式表，**绝不覆盖已有文件**。
  另外为设置面板提供文件接口（`/files`、`/file`、`/file/delete`、`/reveal`）。
- **浏览器半身**（`client.js`）：把样式表注入自己持有的 `<style data-plugin-css="dsh-custom-style">`，
  每 2 秒重新拉取一次（页面隐藏时暂停），所以改完保存就会生效，无需刷新；设置分区通过客户端 slot API 注册。
- **零第三方运行时依赖**：宿主半身只用 `node:` 内置模块，浏览器半身只用 DOM、`fetch` 和平台提供的 React。
  因此 harness 升级不会破坏它；用户 CSS 存在包外，重装插件也不会丢样式。

dsh-custom-style README · 环境要求：- 带 web/桌面客户端的 DeepSeek Harness（`dsh` 0.2.x），已在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上验证。

dsh-custom-style README · 安装：**A. 从插件目录 / npm 安装**（本仓库被收录之后）：

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-custom-style
```

没有构建步骤——`client.js` 是手写的、不是打包产物——所以直接从本仓库源码安装也可以。

**B. 从本仓库安装到当前这台机器**（仓库自带安装器做的事）：

```powershell
node install.mjs            # 只预览（dry run）
node install.mjs --apply    # 安装到 $DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop
```

它会幂等地把插件登记进 DSH profile：

dsh-custom-style README · 安装：| 位置 | 变成什么 |
|---|---|
| `<profile>/local-plugins/dsh-custom-style` | 目录联接 → 本仓库（单一源码）；`--copy` 则改为复制文件 |
| `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-custom-style` | 目录联接 → 上面那一层 |
| `<profile>/package.json` | `dependencies["dsh-custom-style"] = "link:./local-plugins/dsh-custom-style"` 加一条 `dsh.profile.bundles` 登记（改前备份） |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-style/00-starter.css` | 你的样式表——**仅在缺失时**写入 |

浏览器版 DSH 用 `--profile web`；非默认 `DSH_HOME` 用 `--dsh-home <路径>`。
安装后**完全退出并重开 DSH 一次**（宿主半身在启动时注册路由）；之后改 CSS 再也不需要重启。

| 调节：宽视野 (1500px) | 调节：紧凑 (1000px) |
|---|---|
|  |  |

面板分为「调节」、「背景」与「选择器与目录」三页：

| 顶部 tab | 能做什么 |
|---|---|
| **调节** | 八个数字 + 六组预设（宽视野 / 紧凑 / 纵向扩展 / 小巧 / 最大化 / 恢复默认）。预设按钮在输入项**上方**，先套用再微调；点「应用」写入 `20-quick-settings.css` |
| **背景** | 图片地址（填网址，或点「选择图片」从本机挑）/ 遮罩浓度 / 背景模糊 / 平铺方式；带缩略图预览与「清除背景图」 |
| **选择器与目录** | 显示当前 CSS 样式文件存放路径与「打开目录」按钮；提供从 deepseek-harness 源码核对过的稳定选择器举例与一键「复制」代码片段 |

三个 tab 各一页，一次只显示一页。较长的解释收在「说明」折叠里，默认收起。

dsh-custom-style README · 使用：习惯直接改文件也行：编辑 `%DSH_HOME%\dsh-custom-style\`
（默认 `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\dsh-custom-style\`）下的任意 `*.css`——面板和文件夹改的是同一批文件：

```css
/* 01-my-tweaks.css —— 保存后约 2 秒生效 */
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] { width: 1200px !important; }    /* 设置弹窗宽度（默认 800px） */
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] nav { width: 220px !important; } /* 左侧导航宽度（默认 188px） */
body { --dsh-content-font-size: 15px !important; }                /* 会话正文字号 */

dsh-custom-style README · 使用：- 文件名决定拼接顺序（`00-` 在前、`99-` 在后），同特异性下后者胜出。
- 只有在与官方规则**特异性相同**时才需要 `!important`（弹窗宽度就是这种情况）。
- 新建、改名、删除文件都会在下一轮询（≤2 秒）自动反映。
- 想把样式放在别处：设 `DSH_CUSTOM_STYLE_DIR` 为绝对路径，宿主半身会改读那个目录。

dsh-custom-style README · 稳定选择器：完整清单（每条都标了它在出厂 bundle 里的核对出处）见 [selectors.json](selectors.json)。

要找别的元素：DevTools 里选中它 → *Copy selector*，优先挑由 `data-*`、`aria-*`、`role` 组成的写法，
而不是由哈希类名组成的。

> **两条已核实不再成立的选择器**：旧版文档写过的 `[data-shortcut-modal="dialog"]` 与
> `[data-shortcut-modal="shortcut-edit"]`，在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 的出厂 bundle 里**都不存在**——
> 整棵树上 `data-shortcut-modal` 只有 `"settings"` 这一个值。要命中别的模态浮层，
> 请用 `div[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]`。

dsh-custom-style README · 稳定选择器：弹窗自带 `max-width: calc(100vw - 48px)`，所以设得再宽也不会溢出窄窗口。反过来说：窗口比
*你的设定值 + 48px* 更窄时，弹窗其实已经顶到上限——要么把 DSH 窗口拉大，要么自己缩小这条留白
（面板里的「弹窗两侧留白」就是干这个的）：

```css
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] { max-width: calc(100vw - 16px) !important; }
```

dsh-custom-style README · 为什么有些页面右侧还是留白：弹窗宽度只是一半原因。外壳的内容列本身不限宽，但**各个页面会限制自己内容的宽度**，
留白正是这个上限造成的。来自出厂 bundle 的实测：

| 页面 | 被限宽的元素 | 上限 | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 内置插件 | `.amjGKq_section` | 760px | `ui-settings-plugins/lib/client.js:11` |
| 插件市场 tab | `.RotMhW_section` | 760px | `ui-settings-plugin-inventory/lib/client.js:57` |
| 模型 | `._3nPmjq_section` | 720px | `ui-settings-models/lib/client.js:58` |
| 通用设置 | `.zZnCHW_section` | **不限宽** | `ui-settings-general/lib/client.js:618` |
| Agent 循环 / Shell | 无自带样式 | **不限宽** | 这两个包没有 CSS |

text:
dsh-custom-style README · 为什么有些页面右侧还是留白：滚动区是普通块级盒子，所以给被限宽的容器加 `margin-inline: auto` 就能把剩余空间均分——
内容居中而不是贴左——而且对没有限宽的元素这是空操作。第二，被限宽的元素**不是**滚动区的
直接子节点（中间隔着 slot 层），而且它的类名是构建期哈希，所以要按稳定的**后缀**匹配：官方页是
`_section`，第三方页常见 `_root` / `_shell` / `_wrap`。面板里的「内容居中宽度」写的就是这个：
`0` 表示保留各页自己的宽度、只做居中；填数字表示把它们统一成该宽度并居中。

```css
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] [class*="_options"] > *,
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] [class*="_section"],
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] [class*="_root"],
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] [class*="_shell"],

dsh-custom-style README · 工作原理：```
$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-style/*.css
        │  按文件名顺序拼接，每个文件前加一条 "/* ===== 名字 ===== */" 横幅
        ▼
index.js（宿主半身）──GET /dsh-custom-style/all.css──▶  client.js（浏览器半身）

dsh-custom-style README · 工作原理：- 路由面：`GET /dsh-custom-style/all.css`（拼接后的 CSS，`Cache-Control: no-store`）、
  `GET /dsh-custom-style/status` 与 `/files`（JSON：目录、文件列表、字节数）、
  `POST /dsh-custom-style/file` 与 `/file/delete`（写入/删除一个 `*.css`）、
  `POST /dsh-custom-style/reveal`（打开目录）；支持 `HEAD`，其余返回 `404`/`405`/`413`。
- 只读写那个目录**直接**内部的 `*.css`；文件名必须匹配 `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}\.css`——
  不接受调用方传入的路径，因此没有路径穿越面。写入是原子的（临时文件 + rename），单文件上限 256 KiB。
- 插件被卸载时，浏览器半身会移除自己的 `<style>` 并清掉定时器；设置分区来自客户端 slot API
  （`settings.section`），所以它的边框、导航与生命周期都由 harness 掌管。

dsh-custom-style README · 排查：- 看拼接结果：打开 `/dsh-custom-style/all.css`；文件清单与大小：`/dsh-custom-style/status`。
- `Ctrl+Shift+I` → 搜 `data-plugin-css="dsh-custom-style"` 就是注入的完整样式表；
  Console 里 `[dsh-custom-style]` 前缀的日志会报告应用了什么、或拉取为何失败。
- 规则没生效：先确认选择器命中的是哪个元素（DevTools → 检查），再确认是否需要 `!important`。
- 路由 404：宿主半身没加载——检查 `<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里是否有
  `dsh-custom-style`，然后重启 DSH。

dsh-custom-style README · dsh-custom-style：English | [中文](./README.md)

Inject your own CSS into the **DeepSeek Harness** web GUI — dialog width, font sizes, colors, spacing, anything —
by editing plain `*.css` files under `$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-style/`. Saving a file takes effect in about two seconds:
no app patching, no rebuild, no restart.

dsh-custom-style README · dsh-custom-style：It also adds a **Custom CSS section inside the DSH settings dialog**, allowing you to adjust dialog width, height, body text size and content centering with a few numbers, or set a full-screen wallpaper with blur and overlay — so you never have to leave the app to tune the UI.

dsh-custom-style README · dsh-custom-style：- Host half (`index.js`): concatenates `$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-style/*.css` in filename order and serves it at
  `GET /dsh-custom-style/all.css`. The directory and a starter stylesheet are created on first run; existing files are
  never overwritten. It also serves the settings panel's file API (`/files`, `/file`, `/file/delete`, `/reveal`).
- Browser half (`client.js`): injects that stylesheet into its own `<style data-plugin-css="dsh-custom-style">` element
  and re-fetches it every 2 seconds (paused while the page is hidden), so an edit shows up without a reload. The
  settings section is registered through the client slot API.
- No third-party runtime dependencies: the host half uses `node:` built-ins only, the browser half uses DOM, `fetch`
  and the platform-provided React only. A harness update therefore cannot break it, and user CSS lives outside the
  package so reinstalling never loses it.

After installing, **quit and reopen DSH once** (the host half registers its route at startup). Editing CSS never needs a restart again.

| **Tune** | Eight numbers plus six presets (Roomy / Compact / Tall / Small / Maximized / Stock). Preset buttons sit **above** the fields — apply one, then tweak. **Apply** writes `20-quick-settings.css` |

dsh-custom-style README · Usage：Three tabs, one page each. Longer explanations fold into **Details**, collapsed by default.

dsh-custom-style README · Where local images live：A picture you pick with **Choose image** is copied into the style folder's `images/` directory, and the CSS
only references its URL:

```
~/.dsh/dsh-custom-style/
├── 20-quick-settings.css      # contains url("/dsh-custom-style/images/wallpaper-xxxx.png")
└── images/
    └── wallpaper-xxxx.png      # the image itself

Why not inline the image as base64 (which is what I tried first):

dsh-custom-style README · Where local images live：| | base64 inline | file + URL (current) |
|---|---|---|
| Style-file size | 1.33x bigger, hard 256 KiB cap | **none** |
| Large images | exceeds the cap, and the whole stylesheet gets skipped | up to 16 MiB each |
| Backup / moving machines | huge stylesheet, noisy diffs | copy the folder |
| Browser cache | re-parsed on every injection | cached as an image |

Image names carry a content fingerprint (`wallpaper-<hash>.png`), so different versions do not overwrite one another.

dsh-custom-style README · Stable selectors：The dialog keeps its own `max-width: calc(100vw - 48px)`, so a wide setting never overflows a narrow window. The flip side:
in a window narrower than *your width + 48 px*, the dialog is already as wide as it can get — widen the DSH window, or shrink
that inset yourself (the panel's **side margin** field does exactly this):

```css
[data-shortcut-modal="settings"] { max-width: calc(100vw - 16px) !important; }
```

dsh-custom-style README · Why some pages still leave the right side empty：The scroller is a plain block box, so `margin-inline: auto` on a capped container splits the leftover space evenly — the
content sits centered instead of hugging the left — and the rule is a no-op for anything not capped. Second, the capped
element is **not** a direct child of the scroller (the slot layer wraps it) and its class name is a build-time hash, so match it
by the stable *suffix*: `_section` for official pages, `_root` / `_shell` / `_wrap` for third-party ones. That is what the
panel's **content centering** field writes: `0` keeps every page's own width and only centers it; a number sets them all to
that width and centers it.

dsh-custom-style README · How it works：```
$DSH_HOME/dsh-custom-style/*.css
        │  filename order, one "/* ===== name ===== */" banner per file
        ▼
index.js  (host half)  ──GET /dsh-custom-style/all.css──▶  client.js (browser half)

dsh-custom-style README · How it works：- Route surface: `GET /dsh-custom-style/all.css` (concatenated CSS, `Cache-Control: no-store`),
  `GET /dsh-custom-style/status` and `/files` (JSON: directory, file list, byte count),
  `POST /dsh-custom-style/file` and `/file/delete` (write/delete one `*.css`),
  `POST /dsh-custom-style/reveal` (open the folder), `HEAD` supported, `404`/`405`/`413` otherwise.
- Only `*.css` files directly inside that one directory are read or written; a name must match
  `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}\.css` — no caller-supplied paths, so there is no traversal surface. Writes are atomic
  (temp file + rename) and capped at 256 KiB per file.
- The browser half removes its `<style>` element and clears its interval when the plugin is disposed; the settings section
  comes from the client slot API (`settings.section`), so the harness owns its frame, navigation and lifecycle.

dsh-custom-style README · Troubleshooting：- See the concatenated stylesheet: open `/dsh-custom-style/all.css`; file list and sizes: `/dsh-custom-style/status`.
- `Ctrl+Shift+I` → search `data-plugin-css="dsh-custom-style"` for the injected sheet; `[dsh-custom-style]` console lines report
  what was applied or why fetching failed.
- Rule has no effect: check the element the selector actually matches (DevTools → Inspect) and whether `!important` is needed.
- Route 404: the host half is not loaded — confirm `dsh-custom-style` is in `<profile>/package.json` → `dsh.profile.bundles`,
  then restart DSH.

dsh-custom-style README · Preview styles without restarting DSH：```powershell
node tools/local-preview.mjs                                            # temporary style dir, dialog starts at 1200px
node tools/local-preview.mjs --css-dir "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-custom-style"   # preview your real styles
node tools/local-preview.mjs --width 1400 --port 7799
```

dsh-custom-style README · Preview styles without restarting DSH：It serves a mock settings dialog at `http://127.0.0.1:7788/` and drives **the real halves**: the host half concatenates
your styles and serves `/dsh-custom-style/all.css`, the page loads the real `client.js`, which injects and polls.
`GET /__set?w=1400` rewrites the preview stylesheet so you can watch the two-second reload. Nothing leaves the machine,
and DSH itself is not involved.

dsh-custom-style README · Preview styles without restarting DSH：The preview page has no DSH services, so it exercises the stylesheet only: the settings section needs the real harness
(the console prints a `slots` unavailable warning there, which is the intended graceful degradation).

dsh-custom-style README · Development tools：- `tools/asar/` — reads and patches the shipped `app.asar` for changes that genuinely cannot be done with CSS;
  `patch_panel_width.py` edits the settings-dialog width in place with a length-preserving rewrite and can `--revert` it.
  `scan-all-maxwidth.py` lists every `max-width` rule inside the shipped settings bundles (each entry seeks independently —
  reading the filtered entries back-to-back produces false negatives). Set `ASAR_PATH` to your `app.asar` first.
dsh-custom-style README · Development tools：The tools are development aids and are not part of the installed plugin (`files` keeps them out of the npm package).
